tasks.short: Plan, prepare and deliver meals for special dietary needs.

steps.what: Confirm the individuals dietary requirements and clarify the permitted meal choices.
Check approved recipes, ingredients and preparation restrictions for the special meal.
Plan the permitted meal and resolve restrictions with the responsible food-service lead.
Prepare the special meal using the permitted ingredients and handling procedure.
Check the final meal and recipient identity, then deliver the meal personally.

tasks.design: Test a native approved-recipe register in {DOCS} or the existing {OTHER} food-service records system before custom code. Link current ingredients and handling restrictions so the worker can find approved facts quickly, while planning, preparation and final meal-to-recipient checks stay human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recipe sheets, supplier ingredient changes and dietary instructions may be hard to compare.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned recipe records can expose approved ingredients and restrictions together.
tasks.still_hard: Cross-contact, ingredient substitutions and individualized restrictions cannot be established by a document lookup alone.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a preparation or recipient mismatch and stop service until clarified.

ambition.what: Give people with dietary restrictions a clear explanation of the approved meal offered to them.

tasks.altitude: A little less recipe searching; clinical dietary decisions and substitution authority do not move to the counter worker.

reach.task: Prepare an ingredient-label check for a proposed substitution.
reach.learn: Recipe version control and escalation to the food-service lead.

evidence.claim: Apicbase stores allergen and dietary data per recipe, according to the digest; this supports an approved recipe register, not automated individualized dietary decisions.
The digest cites Dutch food-service guidance requiring information about allergens in unpackaged food; this is legal context, not evidence that a recipe record proves safe handling.
Model knowledge: joined approved records can shorten lookup while preparation and recipient checks remain human.

assumptions: Boundary covers meals the focal counter worker is trained and permitted to prepare. Specialist dietary assessment, instruction approval and any separate cook labor are outside and unchanged; no transferred preparation saving is assumed.

Food-service lead supplies recipe_id, version, approved_ingredients, restrictions and handling_procedure; receiving team supplies ingredient_id, supplier_label_version and substitution_status; authorized requester supplies recipient_reference and dated dietary_instruction. Missing or conflicting records stop selection for manual clarification, not model inference.

Test native recipe or document registers first. Dietary information is restricted to staff who need it; access and applicable national employee consultation are included. The only claimed reduction is the lookup step.

Final handover approval in s5 binds prepared meal v1, its actual ingredients and handling confirmation, dietary instruction version and intended recipient. Any substitution, replating or recipient change voids that check.
unknowns: Who may approve dietary instructions and substitutions.
Current recipe completeness, ingredient-change process and access controls.
research_questions: Can staff retrieve the correct approved recipe version without confusing ingredient records with proof of safe preparation?

already_counted.description: Final meal and recipient check before delivery.

incremental.description: Report stale recipe links and ingredient-version conflicts.
Maintain approved recipes, ingredient records and restricted access.

approvals.approved_version: prepared meal v1 plus actual ingredients, handling confirmation, dietary instruction version and recipient; any change voids handover approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=95 gross=5 net=4 after 1 upkeep. Low: approved records already easy to find; high: fragmented recipe lookup. Planning judgement, physical preparation and final delivery checks retain all their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Make approved dietary facts easier to find while preserving preparation care and human handover checks.
role.ambitious_version: A counter worker who can explain an approved dietary meal clearly and stop when facts or handling are uncertain.
